budget.note: profile_ms excludes attention extraction (policy wrapper). policy_infer is client-side wall time of the whole chunk request.

extract_ms_passed_to_analyze._definition: additional extraction ms over the serving L8H2 path: action = 0 (already inside serving policy call; not separately recorded), noun / noun_k3 = median T53 noun prefix_ms (upper bound of extra cost; GPU, not the CPU replay device)
